templates.name: Hello World
templates.description: Simplest possible varg template. Generates a character portrait and animates a hello wave. Great starting point.

variables.name: imagePrompt
variables.default: Editorial portrait photo of a cheerful young woman with bright orange hair

variables.name: videoPrompt
variables.default: She waves hello warmly, smiling at the camera

templates.name: Talking Head
templates.description: AI-generated talking head with lipsync, voiceover, captions, and background music. Full pipeline: character generation, speech, lipsync, and composition.

variables.name: character
variables.description: Character appearance description for image generation

variables.name: script
variables.description: Voiceover text / what the character says

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: upbeat lo-fi background, chill electronic, podcast vibes

templates.name: Talking Head with Logo
templates.description: Talking head with VEED lipsync plus a picture-in-picture logo overlay. Includes captions and background music.

variables.name: logoUrl
variables.description: Logo image URL for picture-in-picture overlay

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: upbeat lo-fi background, chill electronic, podcast vibes

templates.name: Product Showcase
templates.description: 4-scene product advertisement: hero shot, features overlay, lifestyle scene, result reveal, and packshot with CTA. Classic commercial formula.

variables.name: productName
variables.description: Product name for packshot and titles

variables.name: productDescription
variables.description: Product description for image generation prompts

variables.name: script
variables.description: Full voiceover script for the commercial

variables.name: character
variables.default: young professional woman, late 20s, confident smile

variables.name: features
variables.description: List of product features for text overlay

templates.name: Slideshow
templates.description: Data-driven array slideshow. Define items in a list, generate images for each, animate them, and stitch together with background music and a finale group shot.

variables.name: items
variables.description: Array of items, each with 'name' and 'prompt' fields for image generation

variables.name: style
variables.description: Shared visual style applied to all item images

variables.name: groupPrompt
variables.description: Prompt for the finale group image showing all items together

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: cute baby song, playful xylophone, kawaii vibes

templates.name: Adventure Showcase
templates.description: Multi-environment character showcase. 3 dramatic shots per scene (wide, close-up, hero) across different environments like skydiving, arctic, desert. Batch-renderable via sceneIndex.

variables.name: character
variables.description: Character appearance description for consistent generation

variables.name: scenes
variables.description: Scene definitions: [{name, music, a: {image, motion}, b: {image, motion}, c: {image, motion}}]

variables.name: sceneIndex
variables.description: Which scene to render (0-indexed). Omit to render scene 0.

templates.name: Fashion Photoshoot
templates.description: Studio + editorial fashion photography pipeline. Generates character and garment reference images, then produces 3 studio shots and 3 editorial shots with animation. Dual-reference consistency.

variables.name: garment
variables.description: Garment description (e.g. 'oversized vintage band tee, washed black, distressed graphic print')

variables.name: character
variables.default: Young man, mid-20s, sharp cheekbones, tousled dark hair, light stubble

variables.name: characterUrl
variables.description: Pre-generated character image URL (skips character generation)

variables.name: productUrl
variables.description: Pre-generated garment product image URL (skips garment generation)

variables.name: studioShots
variables.description: Custom studio shot prompt descriptions (3 shots)

variables.name: editorialShots
variables.description: Custom editorial shot prompt descriptions (3 shots)

templates.name: Cinematic Tribute
templates.description: 8-scene character montage with reference-based consistency, per-clip trimming, fade transitions, dramatic voiceover, and TikTok-style captions. Vintage film grain aesthetic.

variables.name: character
variables.description: Character appearance description for base portrait

variables.name: style
variables.description: Visual style (film grain, color tones, etc.)
variables.default: vintage color photograph, film grain, desaturated warm tones

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: dark melancholic rock, heavy reverb, slow tempo, raw electric guitar

templates.name: Claymation UGC
templates.description: Plasticine stop-motion product testimonial. 8 scenes with a character-consistent clay figure, voiceover-synced fast cuts, and warm vintage aesthetic.

variables.name: productName
variables.description: Product name (appears on clay bottle prop)

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: quirky upbeat indie, xylophone, handclaps, playful

variables.name: characterPrompt
variables.default: clay office worker, neat hair, tiny glasses, cheerful expression

templates.name: UGC Testimonial
templates.description: Influencer-style product testimonial with segmented voiceover, per-segment lipsync, b-roll product intercuts, and TikTok captions. Portrait format for social.

variables.name: productImageUrl
variables.description: Product reference image URL for b-roll generation

variables.name: scriptSegments
variables.description: Voiceover segments (array of phrases, each gets its own lipsync clip)

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: gentle lo-fi, warm acoustic guitar, soft beats

templates.name: Negative Marketing
templates.description: Fear-hook product advertisement. Expert talking head delivers alarming opener, dramatic b-roll intercuts, then product solution reveal with packshot and CTA.

variables.name: scriptSegments
variables.description: Voiceover segments (array, first segment is the fear hook)

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: dark tense underscore, cinematic, suspenseful, low bass

templates.name: Podcast

variables.name: room
variables.default: modern minimalist podcast studio, warm lighting, acoustic panels

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: lo-fi podcast background, subtle warm pads, minimal

templates.name: Breaking News Reporter

variables.name: scriptSegments
variables.description: 9 voiceover segments (start serious, pivot to product excitement)

variables.name: musicPrompt

templates.name: Layout Demos

variables.name: character
variables.default: woman in her 30s, brown hair, green eyes

templates.name: Phota Single Clip
templates.description: Single image-to-video clip for testing different model combinations. Select image model and video model via variables.

templates.name: Phota Comparison Grid
templates.description: Full 3x2 model comparison grid. Tests 3 image models x 2 video models = 6 labeled clips with music.

variables.name: imagePrompt
variables.description: Image generation prompt (same across all models)

variables.name: videoPrompt
variables.description: Video animation prompt (same across all models)

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: lo-fi chill beats, warm pads, gentle rhythm

templates.name: Phota Elements
templates.description: Image generation + edit showcase. Generates a base scene then transforms into elemental variants (water, lava) and animates as a fast-cut montage.

variables.name: musicPrompt
variables.default: epic cinematic orchestral, building tension, drums

templates.name: Lipsync Comparison
templates.description: Lipsync model comparison. Tests VEED Fabric base with optional sync-v2/v3 re-lipsync at different framing distances (extreme-closeup, mid, far).

templates.name: Sync v3 Test
templates.description: Full-body lipsync test. Generates a base talking video then re-lipsyncs with different text using sync-v3.

variables.name: baseSpeechText
variables.description: Base speech text for initial animation
